Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-consent-evidence-fact

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-consent-evidence-fact defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
first-start-capture-permission First-Start capture permissionCapture permission for the stated purpose or modality under the session's immutable first-Start context. This code alone does not establish permission, restriction, missing consent, withdrawal or uncertainty.
purpose purposeOriginal source purpose evaluated for this contribution under the session's first-Start context.
original-reason original-reasonOriginal source finding reason, preserved without equating its label with the FHIR parent.
original-state original-stateOriginal frozen source applicability state for this contribution.
capture-modality capture-modalityCapture modality to which this contribution's permission fact applies; not the whole record's evidence coverage.
binding-version binding-versionVersion of the immutable source binding supporting this contribution, distinct from report/package/schema version.
evaluated-at evaluated-atPreserved time recorded for the binding's first-Start evaluation; not necessarily the earlier evaluator execution clock.
literal-absence-established literal-absence-establishedTrustworthy immutable assertion that required consent evidence was genuinely absent at first Start, excluding nonqualifying or unavailable evidence.
withdrawal-effective-before-start withdrawal-effective-before-startTrustworthy immutable assertion that withdrawal was already effective at first Start.
withdrawal-effective-at withdrawal-effective-atActual trustworthy withdrawal-effective time; explicitly unavailable if not preserved despite supported pre-Start withdrawal.

name: SpeiroConsentEvidenceFact
title: Speiro Consent Evidence Fact
description: Observable consent-context facts; codes do not themselves express permission outcomes.
